patthana15.85:1.1: Araṇaṃ maggārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nasaraṇo namaggārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā ekaṃ.
patthana15.85:2.1: Araṇaṃ maggahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nasaraṇo namaggahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā ekaṃ.
patthana15.85:3.1: Araṇaṃ maggādhipatiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nasaraṇo namaggādhipati dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā ekaṃ.
